local_environment_provenance.preallocation: Actual local-only environment/status and environment/info must confirm ready, exact shell and cwd URI.
local_environment_provenance.fork_attachment: ThreadFork has no environment parameter. Default local creation is source-derived under absent configuration/minimal environment; every model-bearing turn explicitly selects local before execution.

storage_effects.mode: established native history and index; not fixture-local
storage_effects.user_visible_intent: Only these explicitly scoped synthetic native records. No app create_thread, project creation, archive or deletion. Host inspects actual visibility before model turns.
storage_effects.protected: No credential contents or backend change; no unrelated history/index edits; known concurrent session progress is attributed separately.
storage_effects.cleanup: Stop owned runtimes/helpers; retain exact known synthetic native records. No file deletion or shared-index mutation by this runner.
storage_effects.history_index: Existing thread_history_1.sqlite: exact four-table metadata scope, schema/migrations, ordered unlisted count/digests, admitted owned projection/counts, exact-three concurrent identity-preserving append/monotonic progress. No body columns or whole database hash.

fork_constructor.meaning: Tagged StartThreadOptions::new defaults fallback false; not installed-binary or provider execution proof.

preuser_storage_source.meaning: Tagged live snapshot supports metadata-only read before persisted user turns; pre-user includeTurns can reject. Installed behavior remains a gate.
